t.zh: <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>写成规则是 ⟦∀x. ?P(x)⟧ ⟹ ?P(?t)。倒着用，结论 ?P(?t) 要对上「苏格拉底会死」，而 ?P 后面跟的是 ?t，不是约束变量。?P 是「x会死」、?t 是苏格拉底？还是 ?P 就是「苏格拉底会死」、?t 任意？解不止一个，合一器不猜，元件对不上。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref> as a rule is ⟦∀x. ?P(x)⟧ ⟹ ?P(?t). Backwards, its conclusion ?P(?t) must fit “Socrates is mortal”, but ?P is followed by ?t, not by a bound variable. Is ?P “x is mortal” with ?t Socrates, or is ?P just “Socrates is mortal” with ?t anything? There is more than one solution, the unifier does not guess, and the part does not fit.

t.zh: 证明板上不必倒着走：接在「对所有」那条已知后面，得出的一句再接给别的元件。中途得出一句、再拿来用，写成规则是先证一句 ⟦?A; ⟦?A⟧ ⟹ ?C⟧ ⟹ ?C：倒着用它，多出一个目标 ?A，证出的 ?A 进入下一个目标的已知。从板上的「规则」输入接入；设计出的证明助手会成为新元件「前向推理」，这个输入就是它的「规则」口。
t.en: On the proof board there was no going backwards: was wired after the “for all” given, and what it gave wired on. Getting a sentence on the way and then using it is, as a rule, Have: ⟦?A; ⟦?A⟧ ⟹ ?C⟧ ⟹ ?C. Used backwards it adds a goal ?A, and the ?A proved joins the next goal’s givens. comes in at the board’s input Rules; the proof assistant you design becomes a new part, “Forward”, and that input is its port Rules.

after.zh: 像这样从已知往前推，叫<wiki-ref to="forward"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Reasoning on from a given like this is <wiki-ref to="forward"></wiki-ref>.

becomes: ∀x. Human(x) → Mortal(x); Human(h); Human(?t) → Mortal(?t) ⊢ Mortal(h)
∀x. Bird(x) → Flies(x); Bird(k); Bird(?t) → Flies(?t) ⊢ Flies(k)
Human(j); ∀y. Human(y) → Likes(i, y); Human(?t) → Likes(i, ?t) ⊢ Likes(i, j)

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：从「对所有」那条已知取一个，加进已知，把每个目标变成要的样子。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that takes one from the “for all” given and adds it to the givens, turning each goal into the one wanted.

hint.zh: 先证一句倒着用，第一个目标是一个光秃秃的 ?A。
hint.en: Have used backwards leaves a bare ?A as the first goal.

hint.zh: ?A 由「对所有」那条已知来定：<part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref>接上<part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>。
hint.en: ?A is settled from the “for all” given: <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref> with <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>.
